speaker: Ms Joan Pereira
text: asked	the Minister for Social and Family Development whether the Ministry can consider increasing the parking duration for Class 2 Label Scheme drivers on parking lots for the handicapped, from 60 minutes to two hours.

speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
text: There have been some suggestions to lengthen the 60-minute duration for Class 2 label holders.

speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
text: In deciding on the allowable duration for Class 2 label holders, the Ministry of Social and Family Development (MSF) and the Ministry of National Development (MND) have to take into account the needs of all Class 1 and Class 2 label holders for accessible parking lots.

speaker: Ms Joan Pereira (Tanjong Pagar)
text: Would the Ministry consider granting a separate licence, maybe Class 2A, that will allow the holder a longer parking duration time?

speaker: Ms Joan Pereira (Tanjong Pagar)
text: This could be given on a case-by-case basis, with emphasis on elderly caregivers looking after persons with multiple disabilities.
